I want to like this game sooo bad but I have to be real here. It's just a repetitive RNG simulator of PNGs fighting each other. There is so much dynamics implemented into this game yet the vast majority of those features aren't utilized in any meaningful way what so ever. Literally just a bunch of different flavors with no substance. Contestants somehow know exactly where everyone is from across the map. No one has any survival instincts. Instead of surrendering fights and/or try to patch themselves up they instead engage in 1v4s with critically low health, contestants somehow can effectively fight each other in the middle of a large lake, no mentioning of them being on a boat or a raft. No one seems to even attempt on getting to an airdrop no mater the situation they are in. Nothing really seems to mater, it all really just feels like everyone is on a big flat surface, everyone just mindlessly goes around killing each other and their HP feels like the only stat that actually maters. 

There is so much, yet there is only so little in practice

It's a cheap, small and funny little Hunger Games-like simulator sandbox game where you pick any of the premade fighters and sit back while you watch countless of people survive and fight to the death. It's very similar to the BrantSteele Hunger Games sim, and probably heavily inspired by it too.
It's not much of a game by itself so don't expect much, but it's still a nice little way to pass the time, or if you feel like forcing 100 random people or objects into an average game of PUBG.
It has pretty high customizability too, so you can make [b]really wacky ♥♥♥♥[/b] happen, like Donald Trump being ambushed and killed by a plate of pancakes or a furry teaming up with a space marine from Warhammer 40k.
It has a Steam Workshop too, so you can add stuff from the workshop if you're too lazy to make things yourself, or publish things you've made to the workshop and get like 3 subscribers.
